newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, June 3 - Chittagong - 23 vessels in port of which 5 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 cement clinker, 4 cement, 2 tankers, 1 rapeseed, 1 sugar, 5 repairs. 24 vessels due by 10/6 of which 11 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 foodgrain, 4 tankers, 1 fertiliser, 2 rapeseed, 1 sugar. no berthing delays.

INDIA, June 3 - Bombay - delays expected for vessels due containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 6-7 days, general cargo 2-3 days, 7 vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 14 to discharge, 3 vessels under repairs, 3 awaiting orders. Gang shortage due to holidays. Calcutta - 30 vessels due of which 2 coking coal, 10 product tankers, 7 containers, 1 crude, 2 coal, 1 wheels/pipes, 1 peas, 1 wood, 2 logs, 2 rock phosphate, 1 pulses 6 vessels loading at berth, 16 discharging at berth, 2 bunkering, 1 under repairs. Cochin - ten vessels due, up to 1 days delay, 1 vessel loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 1 general cargo vessel at csl jetty, 1 naval vessel at drydock. Madras - 35 vessels due - delays expected coal/coke 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, 5 vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - five ore vessels due, no delays expected, 1 container vessel due, 6-7 days delay, 1 coke

SRI LANKA, June 3 - Colombo - vessels due 8 containers/feeders, 1 bundle steel. Delays 24-48 hours for containers/feeder, 4-5 days bagged cement, 10-12 days bagged sugar. 10 vessels loading at berth of which 3 essential services, 7 containers. Discharging at berth 4 bagged sugar, 7 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 lpg. 8 containers (feeders) waiting at anchorage to load. 2 vessels Waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 1 bagged.
